attempted_claim: Let C be an irreducible complex projective plane curve of degree 8, rational (geometric genus 0), whose only non-nodal singularities are exactly three ordinary cusps of analytic type A2 (each delta-invariant 1, Tjurina number 2, in pairwise distinct positions) and whose remaining singularities are exactly 18 ordinary nodes. Impose passage through 20 points in general position in P^2. Using the log relative Gromov-Witten degeneration of P^2 along the toric triangle divisor D=L1 union L2 union L3 of three coordinate lines (total class 8L, contact orders partitioning 8 along each line with stated tangency profiles at the three intersection points) with its full degeneration-ledger sum, plus torus localization on the expanded-target moduli spaces, prove finiteness and transversality under the 20 point conditions and determine with proof the exact finite enumerative number N(8,3xA2) counting such tricuspidal curves (each unordered cusp triple counted once). A complete answer is a proved nonnegative integer value together with the certified ledger sum and localization contributions yielding it.
claim_type: exact finite enumerative number with certified ledger
decisive_failure: No exact value for N(8,3xA2) was established and no certified degeneration ledger or localization computation was completed. The dimension count confirms only numerical plausibility, not finiteness, transversality, or enumeration, and the ledger-skeleton bounds show the certification workload is far beyond a single one-hour pass.
